text:
Life is so simple it explains itself,
it is enough unto itself.
Look! Everything is made. Everything is given.
We need only accept
or perhaps—we are human—praise
and sing
to what shapes us without allowing thought.
Everything is here. Don't you see?
There is no reason, no beyond.
We are happy! We live the explosive moments
of joy or pain, rage or love,
and if not,
then we are distracted, bored.
There is nothing to await. Nothing to fear.
Death, too,
will come when it is faithfully needed,
and we shall receive it with true eagerness.
Since birth
we have been preparing to be consumed.

translation.title: Life Is So Simple
